title: Chapter 51 New Rules
content:
Chapter 51 New Rules

"Okay, I'll take both of these." Wang Shuo said with a firm face.

"Also, have you collected the materials for making the Flame Gun that I asked you to collect last time?"

Hadro took out a piece of fine iron ingot, a piece of mithril, and a flame rune directly from his backpack.

"These things, even if you charge 3,000 gold coins, I won't make any money from you."

Wang Shuo thought about it, and the total transaction volume was 16,000 gold coins, so the other party must have made a lot of money.

He calmly chose another "contract scroll".

Then he said: "Mr. Hadro, you know that I am still in the novice trial stage, and it is difficult to collect so many gold coins at once. Can you give me less? After all, I am also your old customer, and there are still many opportunities for cooperation in the future."

"Haha, Lord, you are right. For the sake of our old friendship, you name a number. As long as it can be discounted, I will definitely give it a discount."

"5000?"

Hadro was stunned for a moment, and then laughed after a while: "Lord, you are joking."

"8000?"

"Haha..."

...

After some bargaining, it was finally sold for 15,000 gold coins.

The main thing is that the gun manual can be sold for at least 20,000 gold coins at the auction, so he can't lose a penny of this 10,000 gold coins.

【Earth Emperor Fruit +1, "Dragon Gun Manual" +1, Fine Iron Ingot +1, Mithril +1, Flame Rune +1, Gold Coins -5000, Energy Crystal -1000. 】

Wang Shuo knew that the other party must have made a lot of money from him, but there was nothing he could do about it.

If there was no profit, he would never buy good things from him again.

But if he didn't bargain, he would be easily taken advantage of by the other party.

Although the materials for the Flame Gun had been collected, a blacksmith was still needed to complete the forging.

After the transaction was completed, Wang Shuo prepared wine and food and planned to have a good chat with Hadro.

After all, this kind of peddler who wandered between various forces could definitely provide Wang Shuo with a lot of useful information.

Hadro left after chatting until late at night.

…

On the morning of the 21st day, Wang Shuo came to the yard and took out the "Dragon Spear Art" he bought yesterday. [Are you sure you want to learn "Dragon Spear Art"? 】

"Yes."

In the skill column of Wang Shuo's combat attribute panel, there was an additional skill of "Dragon Spear Art". After clicking it,

[Dragon Spear Art: Yellow-level technique, with nine levels in total, each level can provide basic attributes, all attributes +1, command value +1, attack power +2, and after practicing to the second level, you can also comprehend a skill, Dragon Strike, current level 1, proficiency 0/1000. ]

Originally, it was upgraded with proficiency, it seems that it needs to be upgraded to level 2 quickly, so that there will be an extra attack skill.

He took out the Earth Emperor Fruit again, and after taking it, the command value increased by 10 points. Now the number of soldiers he can lead has increased to 200, which makes Wang Shuo a little excited.

At this time, the voice of Lord Zak sounded again:

[Congratulations to all players for successfully passing the elimination round. I am very satisfied with your performance. Now I will reward the top ten players. ]

[Now announce the current ranking. ]

10th place: Zhang Yang.

9th place: Ye Tianba.

8th place: Liu Dahai.

7th place: Yue Ji.

6th place: Zhao Shanhe.

5th place: Wu Han.

Fourth place: Zhao Tianze.

Third place: Zeta.

Second place: Su Xiu.

First place: Wang Shuo.

The top ten players basically did not change much, only Zhang Yang came from behind and successfully entered the top ten.

[Players ranked after 100 will have their souls sealed and become tools. ]

As soon as the voice fell, the number of survivors in the current area dropped directly to 100.

This operation directly made the surviving players feel a kind of sadness of the rabbit dying and the fox mourning.

Even many players did not have time to leave their last words.

No one who is alive now complains, because they have all adapted to this cruel world.

[4th to 10th place, reward all attributes +1, reputation +10]

[3rd place, reward all attributes +2, reputation +50, gold +1000]

[2nd place, reward all attributes +3, reputation +100, energy crystal +100]

[1st place, reward all attributes +5, reputation +200, soul crystal +10]

[Next we will enter the battle for the "village building order". ]

[Look forward to your excellent performance! ]

After Master Zak finished speaking, the mechanical system female voice began to announce the rules of the game.

[The system fog of Hedong County in Dahuai Domain will dissipate. The remaining 999,000 players automatically obtain the status of refugees and enter the melee stage. ]

[Open the combat profession, players can go to the nearest system town to find a mentor to learn. ]

[Collect 10 shelter hearts to synthesize a bronze village building order. 】

【10 bronze village building orders can be upgraded to silver village building orders, and 10 silver village building orders can be upgraded to gold village building orders...】

【When 100 players have collected gold village building orders, the battle for village building orders ends. 】

【The top ten players will receive generous rewards. 】

[At the end of the game, players who have Sanctuary Hearts but not enough to synthesize Bronze Village Building Orders can go to the system town, hand in their Sanctuary Hearts, and obtain the town's household registration. ]

With the announcement of the rules, the system fog around Wang Shuo's territory began to dissipate.

However, the "air wall" around the territory has not completely disappeared. He can even see that the surrounding player territories are covered by transparent "lids".

Before Wang Shuo had time to digest this information, the "enemies" around him suddenly appeared.

Checking the backpack, he found that he already had 2 Sanctuary Hearts.

This is a good start.

It seems that each player currently has several Sanctuary Hearts in his hands, and the next battle will inevitably enter a white-hot stage.

"Agui, what suggestions do you have?"

"Lord, this battle is mainly to snatch the trial stones in the hands of the players. With our combat effectiveness, we can completely occupy a huge advantage in the early stage, so we should act immediately,..."

Due to time constraints, Chang Gui simply put forward some suggestions. In the early stage, more players should be gathered, which will be beneficial to future development.

Wang Shuo pondered for a moment and felt that what Chang Gui said made sense.

So he gathered his troops and planned to wait until the "protective shield" disappeared before taking action.

He looked at the map again and found that there had been great changes.

He had become a small green dot, and was in a huge map.

The three words "Dahuaiyu" were marked on it, and there were some yellow dots around it, and even some red dots.

Wang Shuo zoomed in on the map and found that his location was called Wadang Mountain. There was a river nearby, called Xiangshui River, and not far below the river, there was a system town called Nanshanji.

At this moment, at the foot of Wadang Mountain, within a radius of ten miles, there were hundreds of players, some in extreme excitement, some in panic, and some with cold faces, without any waves!

Not long after, Dahuang "woofed", and Wang Shuo's territory was completely integrated with the outside world.

Not far to the north is the towering Wadang Mountain, which is covered with dense vegetation and lush green. The other three sides are open areas, and some shelters built by players can be vaguely seen.

"Let's go."

Wang Shuo rode on a warhorse, waved his spear, and rushed out first.

At this moment, he was majestic and had the demeanor of a great general.

Gong Zheng and others followed closely behind, also spurring their horses and galloping away.
